detailed_description: The Regex Generator helps you start from common JavaScript regular expression patterns or type your own custom pattern. Choose a preset such as email, URL, phone, IPv4, date, time, hex color, username, password, ZIP code, credit card, or slug, then test it against sample text with the global, case-insensitive, and multiline flags. Matching text is listed below the test area, and the current pattern can be copied to your clipboard.
usage_steps: Select one of the common pattern buttons or type a custom regular expression
Toggle the global, case-insensitive, or multiline flags as needed
Enter sample text in the test string area
Click Test Pattern to run the pattern with JavaScript RegExp
Review the matching text listed below the test area
Click Copy Pattern to copy the current regular expression
usage_examples: Pick the email preset and test it against a short list of sample addresses
Try a custom pattern against pasted log text to see which substrings match
Compare case-sensitive and case-insensitive matches with the same test string
Copy a URL, IPv4, date, or slug pattern as a starting point for manual refinement
